origin.description: Romberg estimate of the length of a parametric curve.

arguments.name: f
arguments.text: Parametric map. A vector of t returns the coordinates concatenated.

origin.details: Quarter unit circle, at most 8 Romberg rows.
origin.value: Romberg estimate of the length of a parametric curve.
origin.example: with(arclength(function(t) c(cos(t), sin(t)), 0, pi/2, nmax=8), c(length, niter, rel.err))

translation.description: Romberg estimate of the length of a parametric curve.

arguments.name: f
arguments.text: Parametric map. A vector of t returns the coordinates concatenated.

translation.details: Quarter unit circle, at most 8 Romberg rows.
translation.value: Romberg estimate of the length of a parametric curve.
translation.example: np.array([arclength(lambda t: np.concatenate([np.cos(np.atleast_1d(t)), np.sin(np.atleast_1d(t))]), 0, np.pi/2, nmax=8)[k] for k in ('length', 'niter', 'rel.err')])
